WPSS No.2505 of 2018
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. K.K. Harbola, Advocate, 
holding brief of Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, 
Advocate with Mr. B.S. Rawat, 
Advocates for the petitioners. 
Mr. N.P. Sah, Standing Counsel 
for the State of Uttarakhand. 
Heard learned counsel for the 
parties. 
As prayed, four weeks’ time is 
granted to the learned Standing 
Counsel for filing counter affidavit. 
Considering the submission 
advanced by the learned counsel for the 
parties and after going through the 
papers available on record, it is 
directed that there shall be no recovery 
of amount, which has already been 
given to the petitioners, till further 
orders. 
Stay application (CLMA No. 11166 
of 2018) stands disposed of. 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) 
Arpan 01.08.2018
